notes.title: Trouble Comes Twice: Bonus Stories - Out Now!
notes.content:
We just released Trouble Comes Twice: Bonus Stories - an optional DLC that adds twenty to thirty minutes of extra content to the base game in the form of bite-sized short stories! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2898160/Trouble_Comes_Twice_Bonus_Stories/?beta=0]Buy it here![/url]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Love Interest POV: Ever wondered how the love interests view their romance with Hazel and Jace from their perspective?
[*] Wedding-themed Stories: These one-thousand word stories focus on wedding-themed scenarios for every couple, e.g. the proposal, sharing wedding vows
[*] Beach Episode: Spend a day at the beach with Hazel, Jace, and the love interests!
[*] Includes eight new CG illustrations and 2 new chibi CG illustrations
[*] Increases the overall playtime of each romance by 20 to 30 minutes
[/list]

notes.title: Trouble Comes Twice - Out Now!
notes.content:
Trouble Comes Twice is now available here on Steam!  🥳💜

Thank you guys for your patience and your support, we hope you enjoy the game! 😎

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wKq6LYGwCCg;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to announce that Trouble Comes Twice releases July 14th here on STEAM!

It's been a long journey to get here, but we couldn't be more grateful for the support and patience you all have shown us. Now, it's just a little while left until you will get to enjoy the game yourselves.

While you wait, [url=https://twitter.com/FOXGLOVEGAMESS]remember you can always keep an eye on our Twitter for regular updates[/url].

See you on July 14!
